name: Build FreeJumpPlugin

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: windows-latest

    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      with:
        submodules: recursive

    - name: Checkout ACUFixes alongside
      uses: actions/checkout@v4
      with:
        repository: NameTaken3125/ACUFixes
        path: ../ACUFixes

    - name: Setup MSBuild
      uses: microsoft/setup-msbuild@v2

    - name: Build
      run: |
        msbuild ExamplePlugin/ExamplePlugin.vcxproj /p:Configuration=Release /p:Platform=x64

    - name: Upload DLL
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: FreeJumpPlugin
        path: ExamplePlugin/x64/Release/*.dll
